description:
Rocket.Chat is open at the login screen in the browser. Log in with:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Send a direct message to the user "agent.user" with the following exact text:
"Please review the 8.0.0 release notes and confirm compatibility with our production environment. Deadline: Friday EOD."

The message must be sent as a direct (private) message, not in a channel.
